rca_of_the_issue:
Original header had a single flex row with the subtitle nested inside the title's column, while the TourButton sat as a sibling — this constrained the subtitle to the narrow left column under the title, leaving a big empty area under the TourButton on the right. Fix in CardAdmin.js (~line 213): wrapped the header in space-y-1; row 1 = flex row with h1 (min-w-0, text-2xl on mobile / sm:text-3xl) + TourButton (flex-none); row 2 =

subtitle as a sibling spanning the full container width.
